params.name: accountId
params.description: The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

params.name: folderId
params.description: The ID of the folder being accessed.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: Specifies the workspace ID GUID.

params.name: count
params.description: The maximum number of results to be returned by this request.

params.name: include_files
params.description: When set to **true**, file information is returned in the response along with folder information. The default is **false**.

params.name: include_sub_folders
params.description: When set to **true**, information about the sub-folders of the current folder is returned. The default is **false**.

params.name: include_thumbnails
params.description: When set to **true**, thumbnails are returned as part of the response.  The default is **false**.

params.name: include_user_detail
params.description: Set to **true** to return extended details about the user. The default is **false**.

params.name: start_position
params.description: The position within the total result set from which to start returning values.

params.name: workspace_user_id
params.description: If set, then the results are filtered to those associated with the specified userId.
